testcase.name: Scenario: Show Home navigation beside the recent document list: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:4:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show Home navigation beside the recent document list ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And Part23.opd from the disposable package is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the part has an active sketch editing environment ✔ And the recent list contains documents ✔ When the user chooses Home from the View ribbon Switch menu ✔ Then the Home workspace displays Open and New actions in a left navigation rail ✔ And a Recent area appears to the right of the rail ✔ And the Recent area offers list view, grid view, search and filter controls ✔ And the part document remains available as an open tab
